title: Health Technician (EMT)
job_summary: The purpose of this position is to serve as a Health Technician (Emergency Medical Technician) in the Emergency Department. The primary purpose of the position is to perform basic technical health care extender functions within the emergency medical arena in response to various accidents and other emergencies involving injury and illness.

title: Medical Supply Technician
job_summary: At the Indian Health Service (IHS), Medical Supply Technicians do more than process sterile supplies-they help change lives. Guided by our mission to improve the health of American Indian and Alaska Native communities, you'll play a vital role in delivering safe, compassionate care where it's needed most. Join IHS and make a lasting difference.

title: Health System Administrator (CEO)
job_summary: Join the Indian Health Service team at the Great Plains Area Drug Dependency Unit (GPADDU) in Winnebago, NE. Serve as the Chief Executive Officer, leading a multidisciplinary team and guiding residential substance use disorder treatment services to support quality care and positive outcomes for the communities we serve.

title: Nurse (Case Management)
job_summary: The incumbent provides advanced professional nursing case management and care coordination services to eligible American Indian beneficiaries, independently managing complex case management situations, leads quality improvement and program development activities in care coordination. This position is located in the Emergency Department at the Northern Navajo Medical Center, Shiprock, NM.

title: Lead Nurse
job_summary: This position is located in one of two Public Health Service hospitals in the Bemidji Program Area, Indian Health Service. The bed capacities range from 17-19. Inpatient services provided include medical, post surgical, obstetrical, newborn and pediatric. Emergencies are treated on a 24-hour basis and there are regularly scheduled clinics in the outpatient unit.

title: Supervisory Nurse (Medical-Surgical) Inpatient
job_summary: This position is located at the Zuni Comprehensive Community Center, Division of Nursing, Department of Medical-Surgical (Inpatient), Zuni, New Mexico. This position provides technical and administrative supervision to the inpatient nursing staff and provides nursing care services. The incumbent report to the Chief Nurse Executive.

title: Supervisory Physical Therapist
job_summary: This position is located in the Physical Rehabilitation Services Department of the Chinle Service Unit in Chinle, AZ. Directs comprehensive rehabilitation services. Oversees strategic planning, staffing, budget, facilities, equipment, staff competency and development, quality management, age-appropriate patient care, and community education and outreach.
